events.title: KAUNA DEMO update - 2026-10-11
events.summary: Small KAUNA demo update released.Release notes:- Added issue report link to main menu- Better UI scaling for big resolutions- bug fix: Barrel smoke effect not showing- bug fix: Game started muted with some players on first launch

events.title: KAUNA DEMO Released!
events.summary: KAUNA DEMOKAUNA Demo is finally released on Steam! Please go and give it a shot. It has been a long time coming, but the game is now ready to be shared.If you've tried the earlier Itch.io versions, this new demo is now running on the Godot 4 engine, which should make the game run a lot smoother and faster. The demo includes the first three levels, E0M1, E1M1 and E1M2, plus the E1M7 vehicle level. These levels give you a pretty good feel for the game.Wishlist KAUNA and keep an eye for the future
